sys_script.description:
After a new sn_customerservice_case is inserted, calls CaseTriageEngine to invoke the "Order Complaint Triage Assistant" GenAI skill and writes back: • x_2145749_qc_ai_urgency_score — always set (1-10 integer) • x_2145749_qc_complaint_type — set ONLY if currently empty • x_2145749_qc_needs_manual_review — set to true when AI cannot confidently classify
Runs asynchronously (when=async) so Case creation is not blocked by the LLM call latency. Uses a separate GlideRecord update to write the AI fields back to the saved record.
sys_script.name: AI Triage on Case Insert
